{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Israel is a vigorous democracy, unique in the Middle East.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America reaffirms its commitment to Israel's security.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America will ensure that Israel maintains a qualitative edge in military technology over any potential adversaries.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Israel must have secure, defensible borders.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America supports Israel's right to exist as a Jewish state able to defend itself against homicide bombings, rocket and mortar fire, and other attacks against its people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America supports the vision of two democratic states living in peace and security: Israel, with Jerusalem as its capital, and Palestine.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"For the vision of two democratic states to become a reality, the Palestinian people must support leaders who reject terror, embrace the institutions and ethos of democracy, and respect the rule of law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America calls on Arab governments throughout the region to help advance the goal of two democratic states.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America supports Jerusalem as the undivided capital of Israel.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America supports moving the American embassy to the undivided capital of Israel.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
